ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left figure is a schematic diagram of a river channel. In the middle of the river channel there is a mid-channel sandbar labeled “Jia”; beside the sandbar there are branching channels, one of which is labeled P. The question stem states that this river section flows from west to east. The right figure is a statistical chart of the area changes of Jia bar within one year; the horizontal axis is months 1—12, and the vertical axis indicates the size of the area. Reasoning: The question stem says this river is located in China, and China is located in the Northern Hemisphere. Horizontally moving flowing water in the Northern Hemisphere is affected by the geostrophic deflection force and deflects to the right. If the river flows from west to east, then when facing downstream, the right side is the south side; the main current will deflect toward the right bank/south side, and erosion will be relatively strong. On the opposite side where channel P is located, the water flow weakens, and sediment is more likely to silt up. Sediment silting will raise the riverbed and decrease water depth, so channel P will slowly become shallower.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图中甲为河心沙洲，P为沙洲旁的一条分汊河道；题干规定该河段自西向东流。再结合文字“我国”判定其在北半球。应用北半球流水向右偏的规律：东流河段主流偏向右岸/南侧，冲刷较强；P所在的相对一侧水流减弱，泥沙容易淤积。由淤积使河床抬高，得出P河道将慢慢变浅。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：左图为河道示意图，河道中间有一块标注为“甲”的河心沙洲，沙洲旁有分汊河道，其中一条标注为P。题干说明该河段自西向东流。右图为甲洲一年内面积变化统计图，横轴为1—12月，纵轴表示面积大小。
推理：题干说该河位于我国，我国位于北半球。北半球水平运动的流水受地转偏向力影响向右偏。若河流自西向东流，则面向下游时右侧为南侧，主流会偏向右岸/南侧，冲刷较强；P河道所在的相对一侧水流减弱，泥沙更容易淤积。泥沙淤积会使河床抬高、水深减小，所以P河道将慢慢变浅。
